assumption_notes: No post-September actual cash is supplied; October is a full forecast month.
Receipts are a planning assumption, not signed revenue; no growth is assumed.
The downside assumes the customer contributes exactly 25% of forecast receipts and stops all payments from November. Both amount and effective timing need confirmation.
A delayed January hire conservatively retains the recruiter payment in October; the fee timing for a deferred approval is unconfirmed.
Tax reserve reduces available cash by 3000 each month, whether paid or set aside; this is a usable-cash model, not necessarily a bank-balance model.
All other costs remain unchanged if the customer leaves. No future financing, cost reductions, or incremental revenue from the engineer is assumed.
Monthly balances cannot establish intramonth liquidity; collection and payment dates are unavailable.
The source records are explicitly fictional/synthetic. This is a model of those records, not verified live company finances.
